name: La Cochinita
notes: All 4 photos are printed laminated menu boards for the same restaurant. Photo 4 duplicates the Shogi and Teriyaki items shown in photos 1-2 with different handwritten prices (8.00/9.90 vs printed 11.99/15.49); kept the printed board prices and merged rather than duplicating the items. Per-protein items (Nomuraki, Yoshima, Minoru's Bowl) listed as separate dishes since each protein has its own printed price.
